selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: After sitting in the prayer, what two core testimonies does the worshipper make?
questions.answer: He affirms that Allah is one and that Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is Allah’s messenger.

questions.question: What does the worshipper present to Allah while sitting in this part of the prayer?
questions.answer: He offers blessed greetings and prayers of blessing on behalf of all creatures.

questions.question: How is the relationship to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, renewed in this passage?
questions.answer: By sending greetings to him, renewing loyalty to him, and showing readiness to follow his teachings.

questions.question: Why does the worshipper look at the ordered structure of the universe?
questions.answer: To refresh and brighten his faith and to recognize the oneness of the Creator.

questions.question: How is Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, described in relation to Allah’s rule and signs?
questions.answer: He is presented as the one who announces Allah’s lordship, conveys what pleases Allah, and explains the meanings found in creation.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of act is the sunset prayer? Give two descriptions.
questions.answer: It is a pure duty and an elevated act of worship; it is also pleasing and deeply serious.

questions.question: Why is the sunset prayer described as more than a ritual?
questions.answer: Because it is portrayed as an ongoing meeting with Allah and a source of lasting happiness even in a temporary world.

questions.question: What is meant by calling this prayer an unending conversation?
questions.answer: It means the prayer is a continuing relationship of worship and nearness to Allah that goes beyond a brief moment.

questions.question: What is the meaning of offering salutations from one’s own side while also presenting those of all creatures?
questions.answer: It means the worshipper speaks personally before Allah while also joining the praise of all creation.

questions.question: What effect does greeting the Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, have on the worshipper’s conduct?
questions.answer: It renews obedience and strengthens commitment to live by his guidance.

questions.question: How does reflection on the universe support belief in Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: The harmony and wise arrangement of creation point to one Maker, not many competing powers.

questions.question: What role does the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, play regarding the “book” of the universe?
questions.answer: He explains the signs found in creation and helps people understand what they mean.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect faith with observation as well as testimony?
questions.answer: Because belief is being renewed not only by words but also by thinking about the ordered world Allah made.

questions.question: What tone does the passage use when speaking about Maghrib prayer: casual, optional, or weighty?
questions.answer: Weighty, because it presents the prayer as noble, joyful, serious, and deeply meaningful.

questions.question: What contrast is made between the world and the happiness linked to this prayer?
questions.answer: The world is temporary like a guesthouse, but the happiness tied to this prayer is enduring.

questions.question: How does the passage connect Maghrib prayer to lasting happiness?
questions.answer: It presents the prayer as a pleasing act of worship that gives a continuing joy not limited by the passing nature of this world.

questions.question: Which two beliefs are openly declared in the sitting part described here?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness and Muhammad’s prophethood.

questions.question: What is the significance of offering blessings connected to all creatures?
questions.answer: It shows that worship is not isolated; the person joins a larger chorus of created beings in honoring Allah.

questions.question: In what way is loyalty to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, shown here?
questions.answer: Through greeting him and recommitting oneself to follow what he brought.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention the order of the universe as a “palace”?
questions.answer: To highlight beauty, harmony, and purposeful design that lead the mind to the Creator’s unity.

questions.question: What three functions of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, are mentioned?
questions.answer: He announces Allah’s dominion, communicates what Allah approves of, and interprets the signs in creation.

questions.question: How does the passage evaluate Maghrib prayer in terms of human life and dignity?
questions.answer: It treats the prayer as so fitting and noble that failing to appreciate it shows a serious lack in one’s humanity.

questions.question: What makes this prayer a source of permanent happiness according to the passage?
questions.answer: It connects the worshipper with Allah in a lasting way, unlike the temporary nature of worldly life.

questions.question: During the seated part, what does the worshipper acknowledge about Allah and His Messenger?
questions.answer: He acknowledges Allah’s absolute oneness and that Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is truly His messenger.
